rendered:
According to the text, the L- and D-HGNRs give mirror-image CD spectra with two distinct chiroptical peaks at 585 nm and 790 nm[1] (Fig. 1[2] panel c). For the D-HGNRs, the shorter-wavelength peak is positive and the longer-wavelength band is negative, the reverse of the L-HGNRs.

A vision model's reading of the plot puts the D-HGNR peaks slightly differently: a positive peak of about 370 mdeg near 592 nm[3] and a negative band of about −255 mdeg near 830 nm[4]. The values stated in the text are the authoritative ones; the plot readings are only approximate.
